LEVEL L2 · DESIGN TASK · v2
FoodWagon — food delivery landing page
Design the landing page of a food delivery service: search by address, browse deals, popular dishes and featured restaurants, learn how it works and get the app. Desktop web, 1920 wide, light mode. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.
How to work
1. Build exactly the 1 frame below, named exactly as listed. It is a single landing page, so there is no prototype to wire.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The two brand colors and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button and a default Text Field. Design all other states, the header, the footer, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the logo, the photos, the app mockup, the store badges, the social logos and the icons from 04 · Media.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
Frame · goal · must include
The frame name is fixed. The must-include list is grouped by subject and sorted A–Z: it states what is on the page, never where it goes or how it looks.
01_Home
Goal: Find food near you and decide where to order from.
MUST INCLUDE
• App promo: “Install the app” · “It’s never been easier to order food. Look for the finest discounts and you’ll be lost in a world of delectable food.” · Image_App_Mockup · Badge_App_Store · Badge_Google_Play
• Call to action: Photo_CTA_Background · “Are you ready to order with the best deals?” · “Proceed to order” (Icon_Chevron_Right)
• Deals: 3 promo blocks, each with title, copy, “Proceed to order” (Icon_Chevron_Right) and photo (see DATA)
• Discounts: 4 discount cards, each with photo, percent “Off”, dish name and days remaining (see DATA)
• Featured Restaurants: “Featured Restaurants” · 8 restaurant cards, each with photo, discount badge (Icon_Tag), “Fast” badge (Icon_Clock), logo mark with the restaurant’s initials, name, rating (Icon_Star) and open status (see DATA) · “View All” (Icon_Chevron_Right)
• Features: Daily Discounts (Icon_Discount) · Live Tracking (Icon_Tracking) · Quick Delivery (Icon_Quick_Delivery)
• Footer: see DATA (Footer)
• Header: Logo_FoodWagon · “Deliver to:” (Icon_Map_Marker) · “Current Location” · “Mohammadpur Bus Stand, Dhaka” · “Search Food” (Icon_Search) · “Login” (Icon_User)
• Hero: Photo_Hero_Background · Photo_Hero_Noodles · “Are you starving?” · “Within a few clicks, find meals that are accessible near you” · tabs Delivery (Icon_Motorcycle) · Pickup (Icon_Shopping_Bag) · current: Delivery · address field “Enter Your Address” (Icon_Map_Marker) · “Find Food” (Icon_Search)
• How it works: “How does it work” · 4 steps, each with icon, title and text (see DATA)
• Popular items: “Popular items” · previous / next (Icon_Chevron_Left, Icon_Chevron_Right) · 5 item cards, each with photo, name, restaurant (Icon_Map_Marker), price and “Order Now” (see DATA)
• Search by Food: “Search by Food” · “View All” (Icon_Chevron_Right) · previous / next (Icon_Chevron_Left, Icon_Chevron_Right) · Pizza · Burger · Noodles · Sub-sandwich · Chowmein · Steak, each with its photo (Photo_Food_Pizza … Photo_Food_Steak)
LINKS
Single-page task: no links between frames. Every button and link is entry only.
Navigation structure
• One frame. The header and footer are part of it.
• Entry only (no frame): location, Search Food, Login, Delivery / Pickup, Find Food, discount cards, Order Now, carousel arrows, restaurant cards, View All, food categories, store badges, Proceed to order, city links, footer links, Subscribe, social logos.
